signature.comparison: Evaluate correct CI and reversed IC predictions against the same heldout CI answers. Also compare the learned hidden commutator CI-IC with true hidden difference h(T_CI x)-h(T_IC x). Report all four conditions, splits and source repeats.
signature.scope: Secondary diagnostic only; no training, tuning or alteration of fixed primary success criteria. IC tested against its own answers is a separate existing diagnostic; this analysis uses CI truth for both orders.
